author: wolovim
content: hey dhanush 👋 with the calls, curious if you find forkcast lacking in some dimension (feature requests welcome) or if youre just interested in competing for public good "market share" here for whatever reason?

author: dhanush0512
content: Hey! The idea is to complement. EIPsInsight also covers other Ethereum ecosystem meetings that aren’t currently listed on Forkcast, helping the community follow discussions in one place like EIPIP & EIP Office Hour.

author: dhanush0512
content: I’m curious about your perspective, though. Is there something we might be overlooking that raises concerns about EIPsInsight offering this feature? We’d appreciate your feedback and are always open to collaboration. Ultimately, we’re all working toward the same goal of keeping the community informed. :)

author: wolovim
content:
i do have a data integrity concern, e.g., "Glamsterdam will proceed with current spec (no changes); Hoodi fork targeting week of Dec 14 — formal go/no-go at next ACDC" imo is inaccurate to call this the settled conclusion at this stage. i understand you are utilizing the output from acdbot, but i want to stress that i treat that output as (often unreliable) input into further data processing on the forkcast side.

forkcast not supporting the eip meetings dates back to old devops headaches basically, because those meetings run on a different zoom account. i should take another look and make the effort to bring those into forkcast in some capacity again.

ultimately its your thing - do whatever you want, but if you want product advice, imo: there’s more valuable pursuits than spending your energy competing on meeting summary quality (you can link out to or cite forkcast if you want). were competing for the same audience (core devs & adjacent) when we post side by side here, so that doesnt grow the pie. the much bigger opportunity out there is to continue to improve on how we reach other stakeholders outside of this small persona group, and tailor comms to what they need to know and when. ill be playing with this idea too, but that sort of outreach is a job for many. in general though, id encourage figuring out how to best support other bottlenecks. related to your original domain, moving eips more efficiently through the pipeline or raising the floor or ceiling on their data quality, for example, feels like a more valuable exercise. just my 2 wei. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ 

happy to follow up via dm

author: dhanush0512
content:
Thanks for the feedback! I agree that data integrity matters, but it should be addressed at the canonical source so all tools benefit, not just Forkcast or EIPsInsight.

In an open-source ecosystem, sharing is caring, and having choices is a strength.

I was mainly looking for feedback, but I appreciate the product advice too. EIPs remain our core focus, and we’re committed to making the process more seamless and accessible for everyone. This Discord is just one of several places where we share meeting artifacts. :)

Happy to continue in DMs!

author: wolovim
content: pm does have the canonical sources: transcript and chat logs
